crossRefs.note: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before…
Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,
but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being…
I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

translations.web: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
translations.bsb: A third time he said to them, “What evil has this man done? I have found in Him no offense worthy of death. So after I punish Him, I will release Him.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
translations.asv: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath this man done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him and release him.
